S.FORM: izua marekaka a maḍusa, neka nu kina, neka nu kama, mapuɫu tiamadju.
S.PHON: izua marəkaka a maɖusa nəka nu kina nəka nu kama mapuʎu tiamaɉu
S.FORM: izua marekaka a madrusa, neka nu kina, neka nu kama, mapulju tiamadju.
S.PHON: izua marəkaka a maɖusa nəka nu kina nəka nu kama mapuʎu tiamaɉu
S.TRANSL: There were two children with no mother or father, all on their own.

S.PHON: vaik a səma vavua
vaik a səma vavua
S.TRANSL: They went to the fields.

S.PHON: izua a sa vuɭuvuɭuŋ
izua a sa vuɭuvuɭuŋ

TRANSL.notes: [Female designation based on women’s work of making thread.]

S.TRANSL: There was Granny Vuluvulung.

S.PHON: vaik a səma zua marəkaka
vaik a səma zua marəkaka
S.TRANSL: The children went over to her.

S.FORM: "pai ku tulu-aw mun tua sika sengsengan."
S.PHON: pai ku tuɭuaw mun tua sika səŋsəŋan
S.FORM: "pai ku tulu-aw mun tua sika sengsengan."
S.PHON: pai ku tuɭuaw mun tua sika səŋsəŋan
S.TRANSL: She said: "Right, I'll teach you how to work the fields."

S.PHON: vaik a səma umaq
vaik a səma umaq
S.TRANSL: They went off home.

S.PHON: ka maʎiaŋa sau kitatuzuŋanu marəkaka
ka maʎiaŋa sau kitatuzuŋanu marəkaka
S.TRANSL: Next day she said: "Siblings, go and get some poles."

S.PHON: vaik a kitatuzuŋan
vaik a kitatuzuŋan
S.TRANSL: They went to find some poles.

S.FORM: i umaq a vuvu a tsemalitsalis.
S.PHON: i umaq a vuvu a ʦəmaɭiʦaɭis
S.FORM: i umaq a vuvu a cemalicalis.
S.PHON: i umaq a vuvu a ʦəmaɭiʦaɭis
S.TRANSL: Grandmother stayed in the house making thread.

S.FORM: ka mangtjez a marekaka a nakitatuzungan, "vuvu, mavatsuvatsuk anga qaliqali, vuvu."
S.PHON: ka maŋcəz a marəkaka a nakitatuzuŋan vuvu mavaʦuvaʦuk aŋa qaɭiqaɭi vuvu
S.FORM: ka mangtjez a marekaka a nakitatuzungan, "vuvu, mavacuvacuk anga qaliqali, vuvu."
S.PHON: ka maŋcəz a marəkaka a nakitatuzuŋan vuvu mavaʦuvaʦuk aŋa qaɭiqaɭi vuvu
S.TRANSL: When the children came back after finding some poles, they said: "Grandmother, other people are clearing their land for planting."

S.PHON: maɭiʦəŋ
maɭiʦəŋ
S.TRANSL: "Be quiet.

S.PHON: nu mavaʦuvaʦuk aŋa kəmuda
nu mavaʦuvaʦuk aŋa kəmuda
S.TRANSL: What if they are clearing the land?

S.PHON: qaɉaw aŋa
qaɉaw aŋa
S.TRANSL: It's up to them.

S.FORM: sa-u, ɫa qunu, kimu tua tsuqelaɫ."
S.PHON: sau ʎa qunu kimu tua ʦuqəɭaʎ
S.FORM: sa-u, lja qunu, kimu tua cuqelalj."
S.PHON: sau ʎa qunu kimu tua ʦuqəɭaʎ
S.TRANSL: Go and find some bones, children."

S.FORM: vaik a masi kaɫaudjul; ɫemuɫu tua tsuqelaɫ.
S.PHON: vaik a masi kaʎauɉuɭ ʎəmuʎu tua ʦuqəɭaʎ
S.FORM: vaik a masi kaljaudjul; ljemulju tua cuqelalj.
S.PHON: vaik a masi kaʎauɉuɭ ʎəmuʎu tua ʦuqəɭaʎ
S.TRANSL: They went off with a basket and picked up some bones.

S.PHON: kamsəŋ aŋa vuvu
kamsəŋ aŋa vuvu
S.TRANSL: "Is that enough, grandmother?"

S.PHON: ini anan ka kamsəŋ
ini anan ka kamsəŋ
S.TRANSL: "It's not enough yet;

S.PHON: sau aɭapu anan
sau aɭapu anan
S.TRANSL: go and get some more."

S.PHON: su sikuda vuvu a su ʦaɭiʦaɭisən
su sikuda vuvu a su ʦaɭiʦaɭisən
S.TRANSL: "Grandmother, what are you going to do with the thread you're making?"

S.PHON: inika sikuda
inika sikuda
S.TRANSL: "Nothing.

S.FORM: sa-u, kimu tua vat nua ɫui."
S.PHON: sau kimu tua vat nua ʎui
S.FORM: sa-u, kimu tua vat nua ljui."
S.PHON: sau kimu tua vat nua ʎui
S.TRANSL: Go and find some gourd seeds."

S.FORM: ka makatsalis anga ti sa Vuluvulung, "ari anga, ɫa qunu, savavua-i.
S.PHON: ka makaʦaɭis aŋa ti sa vuɭuvuɭuŋ ari aŋa ʎa qunu savavuai
S.FORM: ka makacalis anga ti sa Vuluvulung, "ari anga, lja qunu, savavua-i.
S.PHON: ka makaʦaɭis aŋa ti sa vuɭuvuɭuŋ ari aŋa ʎa qunu savavuai
S.TRANSL: When Granny Vuluvulung had finished making thread, she said: "Right, children, let's go to the fields.

S.FORM: katsu a tatuzungan katua tsuqelaɫ katua vat nua ɫui."
S.PHON: kaʦu a tatuzuŋan katua ʦuqəɭaʎ katua vat nua ʎui
S.FORM: kacu a tatuzungan katua cuqelalj katua vat nua ljui."
S.PHON: kaʦu a tatuzuŋan katua ʦuqəɭaʎ katua vat nua ʎui
S.TRANSL: Take the poles, bones and gourd seeds."

S.FORM: ka zemuker i vavua, "sa-u, ɫa qunu, tsektsekan tsa tatuzungan."
S.PHON: ka zəmukər i vavua sau ʎa qunu ʦəkʦəkan ʦa tatuzuŋan
S.FORM: ka zemuker i vavua, "sa-u, lja qunu, cekcekan ca tatuzungan."
S.PHON: ka zəmukər i vavua sau ʎa qunu ʦəkʦəkan ʦa tatuzuŋan
S.TRANSL: When they got to the fields, she said: "Children, go and stick the poles in the ground.

S.FORM: ka sinitsektsek anga, sipaqadjay a tsalis pakipalinguɫ, sa viɫviɫen ni sa Vuluvulung.
S.PHON: ka siniʦəkʦək aŋa sipaqaɉaj a ʦaɭis pakipaɭiŋuʎ sa viʎviʎən ni sa vuɭuvuɭuŋ
S.FORM: ka sinicekcek anga, sipaqadjay a calis pakipalingulj, sa viljviljen ni sa Vuluvulung.
S.PHON: ka siniʦəkʦək aŋa sipaqaɉaj a ʦaɭis pakipaɭiŋuʎ sa viʎviʎən ni sa vuɭuvuɭuŋ
S.TRANSL: When they were stuck in, Granny Vuluvulung tied them with the thread all round and pulled it tight.

S.PHON: kavaɭa kana kinasəŋsəŋan aŋa aja
kavaɭa kana kinasəŋsəŋan aŋa aja
S.TRANSL: "It would be good if the work were all done," they said.

S.PHON: qau kinasəŋsəŋan aŋa
qau kinasəŋsəŋan aŋa
S.TRANSL: So it was all done.

S.FORM: "sa-u, taleman tsa tsuqelaɫ katua vat nua ɫui.
S.PHON: sau taɭəman ʦa ʦuqəɭaʎ katua vat nua ʎui
S.FORM: "sa-u, taleman ca cuqelalj katua vat nua ljui.
S.PHON: sau taɭəman ʦa ʦuqəɭaʎ katua vat nua ʎui
S.TRANSL: "Go and plant the bones and the gourd seeds.

S.FORM: azua tsuqelaɫ taleman pakateku nu upu; azua ɫui pakavavaw nu upu."
S.PHON: azua ʦuqəɭaʎ taɭəman pakatəku nu upu azua ʎui pakavavaw nu upu
S.FORM: azua cuqelalj taleman pakateku nu upu; azua ljui pakavavaw nu upu."
S.PHON: azua ʦuqəɭaʎ taɭəman pakatəku nu upu azua ʎui pakavavaw nu upu
S.TRANSL: Plant the bones below the terrace wall, and the gourds above it."

S.FORM: qau vaik tiamadju a sema umaq.
S.PHON: qau vaik tiamaɉu a səma umaq
S.FORM: qau vaik tiamadju a sema umaq.
S.PHON: qau vaik tiamaɉu a səma umaq
S.TRANSL: Then they went home.

S.FORM: "sa-u, ɫiɫavu a tja quma, nuki kemudakudanga."
S.PHON: sau ʎiʎavu a ca quma nuki kəmudakudaŋa
S.FORM: "sa-u, ljiljavu a tja quma, nuki kemudakudanga."
S.PHON: sau ʎiʎavu a ca quma nuki kəmudakudaŋa
S.TRANSL: "Go and look at our field, to see how it's getting on."

S.PHON: vaik a ʎəmiʎaw tiamaɉu
vaik a ʎəmiʎaw tiamaɉu
S.TRANSL: They went to have a look.

S.FORM: ka mangtjez i umaq, "kemudakudanga, ɫa qunu?"
S.PHON: ka maŋcəz i umaq kəmudakudaŋa ʎa qunu
S.FORM: ka mangtjez i umaq, "kemudakudanga, lja qunu?"
S.PHON: ka maŋcəz i umaq kəmudakudaŋa ʎa qunu
S.TRANSL: When they got home, she asked: "How is it, children?"

S.PHON: patagiʎ a minʦəkas vuvu
patagiʎ a minʦəkas vuvu
S.TRANSL: "There are beginning to be cracks in the ground, grandmother.

S.PHON: makəsaŋa a vaqu nua qaɭiqaɭi
makəsaŋa a vaqu nua qaɭiqaɭi
S.TRANSL: Other people's millet is ripe."

S.PHON: kudain nu makəsaŋa kəmuda
kudain nu makəsaŋa kəmuda
S.TRANSL: "What? What if it is ripe?"

S.PHON: vaik tiamaɉu a səma vavua
vaik tiamaɉu a səma vavua
S.TRANSL: They went to the fields.

S.PHON: kaʦu tua vaɭaŋa tua qasəɭu
kaʦu tua vaɭaŋa tua qasəɭu
S.TRANSL: "Take a pestle and mortar."

S.FORM: ka zemker i vavua, "sa-u patsunu, ɫa qunu.
S.PHON: ka zəmkər i vavua sau paʦunu ʎa qunu
S.FORM: ka zemker i vavua, "sa-u pacunu, lja qunu.
S.PHON: ka zəmkər i vavua sau paʦunu ʎa qunu
S.TRANSL: When they got to the fields, she said: "Children, go and look.

S.PHON: nu ɖəmuŋaɖuŋaɭ aŋa aɭapu
nu ɖəmuŋaɖuŋaɭ aŋa aɭapu
S.TRANSL: If there is anything grunting, pick it up."

S.PHON: azua ʦuqəɭaʎ masan nu qaʦaŋ
azua ʦuqəɭaʎ masan nu qaʦaŋ
S.TRANSL: The bones had become pigs,

S.PHON: azua ʎui masan nu vaqu
azua ʎui masan nu vaqu
S.TRANSL: and the gourds had become millet.

S.FORM: tsemuɫu tiamadju; san qavay i vavua.
S.PHON: ʦəmuʎu tiamaɉu san qavaj i vavua
S.FORM: cemulju tiamadju; san qavay i vavua.
S.PHON: ʦəmuʎu tiamaɉu san qavaj i vavua
S.TRANSL: They butchered the pigs, and made millet dumplings there in the fields.

S.FORM: "sa-u, alapu a penuɫat a vangaɫ nua ɫui a pasa tapaw.
S.PHON: sau aɭapu a pənuʎat a vaŋaʎ nua ʎui a pasa tapaw
S.FORM: "sa-u, alapu a penuljat a vangalj nua ljui a pasa tapaw.
S.PHON: sau aɭapu a pənuʎat a vaŋaʎ nua ʎui a pasa tapaw
S.TRANSL: "Go and put all the produce of the gourds in the shed,

S.FORM: sa nu sutseveɫen a qatsang a penuɫat.
S.PHON: sa nu suʦəvəʎən a qaʦaŋ a pənuʎat
S.FORM: sa nu suceveljen a qacang a penuljat.
S.PHON: sa nu suʦəvəʎən a qaʦaŋ a pənuʎat
S.TRANSL: and dig out all the pigs."

S.FORM: ari vaiki anga, ɫa qunu, a sema umaq.
S.PHON: ari vaiki aŋa ʎa qunu a səma umaq
S.FORM: ari vaiki anga, lja qunu, a sema umaq.
S.PHON: ari vaiki aŋa ʎa qunu a səma umaq
S.TRANSL: (Later she said:) "Come on, children, let's go home.

S.PHON: cukuɖu ʦa ʎui
cukuɖu ʦa ʎui
S.TRANSL: Carry the gourds on your backs."

S.FORM: sa azua qatsang uaguin a pasa umaq.
S.PHON: sa azua qaʦaŋ uaguin a pasa umaq
S.FORM: sa azua qacang uaguin a pasa umaq.
S.PHON: sa azua qaʦaŋ uaguin a pasa umaq
S.TRANSL: And they drove the pigs home.

S.FORM: ka zemuker i umaq, "sa-u katsu, ɫa qunu, sa nu kula sa nu qavuvung a kivala."
S.PHON: ka zəmukər i umaq sau kaʦu ʎa qunu sa nu kuɭa sa nu qavuvuŋ a kivaɭa
S.FORM: ka zemuker i umaq, "sa-u kacu, lja qunu, sa nu kula sa nu qavuvung a kivala."
S.PHON: ka zəmukər i umaq sau kaʦu ʎa qunu sa nu kuɭa sa nu qavuvuŋ a kivaɭa
S.TRANSL: When they got home, she said: "Off you go, children, take legs and hearts (from the butchered pigs) and go where you like."

S.FORM: ka patsun a qaliqali, "ii, puvuvu tua qaqa," aya qaliqali.
S.PHON: ka paʦun a qaɭiqaɭi ii puvuvu tua qaqa aja qaɭiqaɭi
S.FORM: ka pacun a qaliqali, "ii, puvuvu tua qaqa," aya qaliqali.
S.PHON: ka paʦun a qaɭiqaɭi ii puvuvu tua qaqa aja qaɭiqaɭi
S.TRANSL: When other people saw them, they said: "Ha ha, they've got a crow for a grandmother."

S.FORM: qau vaik a pasemalaw tua vuvu.
S.PHON: qau vaik a pasəmaɭaw tua vuvu
S.FORM: qau vaik a pasemalaw tua vuvu.
S.PHON: qau vaik a pasəmaɭaw tua vuvu
S.TRANSL: The children went and told the grandmother:

S.FORM: "'ii, puvuvu tua qaqa,' aya qaliqali, vuvu."
S.PHON: ii puvuvu tua qaqa aja qaɭiqaɭi vuvu
S.FORM: "'ii, puvuvu tua qaqa,' aya qaliqali, vuvu."
S.PHON: ʔii puvuvu tua qaqaʔ aja qaɭiqaɭi vuvu
S.TRANSL: "Grandmother, other people say: 'Ha ha, they've got a crow for a grandmother.'"

S.PHON: nu aja qaɭiqaɭi uri kəmuda
nu aja qaɭiqaɭi uri kəmuda
S.TRANSL: "What if people say that?"

S.PHON: qau vaik a kivaɭa
qau vaik a kivaɭa
S.TRANSL: They went out again.

S.PHON: ii puvuvu tua qaqa aja qaɭiqaɭi
ii puvuvu tua qaqa aja qaɭiqaɭi
S.TRANSL: People said: "Ha ha, they've got a crow for a grandmother."

S.PHON: vaik a cumaq
vaik a cumaq
S.TRANSL: They went home.

S.FORM: "'ii, puvuvu tua qaqa,' aya qaliqali," aya uta.
S.PHON: ii puvuvu tua qaqa aja qaɭiqaɭi aja uta
S.FORM: "'ii, puvuvu tua qaqa,' aya qaliqali," aya uta.
S.PHON: ʔii puvuvu tua qaqaʔ aja qaɭiqaɭi aja uta
S.TRANSL: Again they said: "People say: 'Haha, they've got a crow for a grandmother.'"

S.FORM: "ui, uri vaik aken nu maya," sa "qaqa," aya timadju a vaik.
S.PHON: ui uri vaik akən nu maja sa qaqa aja timaɉu a vaik
S.FORM: "ui, uri vaik aken nu maya," sa "qaqa," aya timadju a vaik.
S.PHON: ui uri vaik akən nu maja sa qaqa aja timaɉu a vaik
S.TRANSL: "All right, in that case I'm off."So she said "Caw caw," and went off.

S.PHON: ka vaik aŋa ɉapəsən nimaɉu
ka vaik aŋa ɉapəsən nimaɉu
S.TRANSL: When she had gone she whistled:

S.PHON: uʎa nəkaŋa nu ɭami nu qaʦaŋ
uʎa nəkaŋa nu ɭami nu qaʦaŋ
S.TRANSL: "May the food and pigs vanish."

S.PHON: qau nəkaŋa nu anəmanəmaŋa
qau nəkaŋa nu anəmanəmaŋa
S.TRANSL: Then there was nothing left.

S.FORM: a matsuɫanga tiamadju a tsemikel, saka izuanga a qemauqaung.
S.PHON: a maʦuʎaŋa tiamaɉu a ʦəmikəɭ saka izuaŋa a qəmauqauŋ
S.FORM: a maculjanga tiamadju a cemikel, saka izuanga a qemauqaung.
S.PHON: a maʦuʎaŋa tiamaɉu a ʦəmikəɭ saka izuaŋa a qəmauqauŋ
S.TRANSL: They were back to being hungry, and they just cried.

S.FORM: "kavala ka izuanan ti vuvu; inika tjen a kipaulaula tua tja kanen," aya tiamadju a kinemnem, ka vaik anga ti sa Vuluvulung.
S.PHON: kavaɭa ka izuanan ti vuvu inika cən a kipauɭauɭa tua ca kanən aja tiamaɉu a kinəmnəm ka vaik aŋa ti sa vuɭuvuɭuŋ
S.FORM: "kavala ka izuanan ti vuvu; inika tjen a kipaulaula tua tja kanen," aya tiamadju a kinemnem, ka vaik anga ti sa Vuluvulung.
S.PHON: kavaɭa ka izuanan ti vuvu inika cən a kipauɭauɭa tua ca kanən aja tiamaɉu a kinəmnəm ka vaik aŋa ti sa vuɭuvuɭuŋ
S.TRANSL: "If only grandmother was still here. Then we wouldn't be in trouble over our food," they thought, when Granny Vuluvulung had gone.

S.PHON: amin
amin
S.TRANSL: The end.
